data.title: Luxor
data.about:
Welcome to Luxor by Imtiaz, a refined residential destination nestled in the heart of Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC), Dubai. Developed by Imtiaz Developments, Luxor offers an exceptional lifestyle that harmonizes elegance, comfort, and urban convenience. Choose from a selection of meticulously crafted studio, 1 and 2-bedroom apartments, each designed to reflect timeless splendor and contemporary finesse.

With thoughtful architecture and premium finishes, Luxor redefines luxury living through its fully furnished smart homes. From rooftop leisure spaces to a world-class gym, and from a stylish club room to a serene sky garden, every detail is curated to elevate everyday life. Luxor by Imtiaz at JVC combines strategic location, state-of-the-art features, and exceptional amenities to offer an upscale lifestyle in one of Dubai’s most connected communities.

characteristics_module.title: Experience Refined Urban Living at Luxor by Imtiaz Developments at JVC
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Location in Jumeirah Village Circle – Enjoy quick access to major highways and vibrant city hubs.
  • Fully Furnished Residences – Well-built homes with tasteful interiors and quality appliances.
  • Smart Home Features – Advanced automation systems for security, comfort, and energy efficiency.
  • Premium Amenities – Sky garden, rooftop pool, gym, theater, business center, and more.
  • Renowned Developer – Built by Imtiaz Developments, a trusted name in innovative real estate.
  • High ROI Potential – Located in a growth hotspot with strong rental demand.
  • Attractive Pricing – Luxury living at a competitive starting price point.
  • Flexible Payment Plans – Designed to ease the purchase process with structured installments.

location_tile.title: A Well-Connected Address in the Heart of New Dubai
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Luxor is ideally situated in Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC), one of Dubai’s fastest-growing communities. With direct access to Al Khail Road (E44) and close proximity to Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road (E311), residents will enjoy effortless connectivity to every major destination in the city. Whether commuting to work or enjoying leisure across the emirate, Imtiaz Luxor at JVC Dubai offers both convenience and prestige.

  • 7 Minutes – Circle Mall
  • 10 Minutes – Dubai Sports City
  • 15 Minutes – Motor City
  • 15 Minutes – Dubai Hills Estate
  • 20 Minutes – Mall of the Emirates
  • 22 Minutes – Downtown Dubai
